backgrounds: Single location for the entire episode: the interior of an old boxy sedan (stop-motion felt/claymation style), shot from the back seat looking forward through the windshield. The car is stuck in dense, foggy morning traffic on a highway/overpass, with rows of blurred vehicles ahead (their brake lights glowing red) and hazy, indistinct city buildings in the far background. The soft-focus gray fog and traffic give a monotonous, gridlocked commute feel; there is no cut to any other set or location.
props: Car interior details: steering wheel, rear-view mirror, headrests, seatbelts, dashboard with center console/radio buttons, gear shifter
Takeaway coffee cup with visible steam, held by the female passenger
Rows of other cars in traffic ahead, with illuminated red brake/tail lights
Bright yellow 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' torn-paper/ticket-style graphic sticker used in the end card
On-screen text overlays: episode title 'I HATE MONDAYS', episode number ('Episode 45'), and show branding 'LOW BATTERY PEOPLE / Created by NIN.'
lighting_notes: Flat, overcast/diffused daylight consistent with a foggy morning traffic jam; soft, low-contrast lighting with no strong shadows on the characters. The car interior is slightly dimmer and cooler-toned than the bright hazy exterior visible through the windshield, creating gentle depth-of-field separation between the sharply lit characters in the foreground and the soft-focus background traffic.
visual_complexity_notes: Minimal, stylized single-set staging: one static camera setup (back-seat POV) reused across the whole episode with only close-up/medium reframing on the two characters. The background traffic is deliberately soft-focus and repetitive/blurred, pushing all visual attention onto the two puppet characters' faces and body language in the foreground, which suits the dialogue-driven, deadpan comedic tone.
